title: Lesson Schema
description: Schema for lesson definition files. Note: This schema validates lesson content (JSON structure), not file paths. Files should be organized hierarchically (curriculum/lessons/P01/M01/L01/P01-M01-L01.lesson.json) and named with .lesson.json extension.

estimated_minutes.description: Estimated time to complete lesson (15-90 minutes)

prerequisites.description: List of prerequisite lesson IDs that must be completed first

learning_objectives.description: What the learner will be able to do after completing this lesson

outline.description: Ordered list of lesson sections. CRITICAL: Conceptual sections must come first, hands-on exercises must come last.

outline_structure_notes.description: Optional guidance on outline organization (e.g., 'Sections 1-6 are conceptual, sections 7-8 are hands-on exercises')

checkpoint_placement_guidance.description: Optional guidance for Professor on where to place checkpoints (e.g., 'After section 3, after section 6, after final exercise')

key_terms.description: Important vocabulary introduced in this lesson

feature.description: Which CatchBook feature this lesson contributes to

deliverable.description: What the learner will build/ship for CatchBook

code_location.description: Where in the CatchBook codebase this work will live

catchbook_context.description: How this lesson integrates with CatchBook project

criteria.description: What learner must demonstrate to pass assessment

professor_constraints.description: Special instructions for Professor role (tone, examples to include/avoid, pacing, etc.)
